## What changed

Explain the change in plain language.

## Why it changed

Name the problem, affected people, and evidence behind the decision.

## Safety and trust check

- [ ] I separated established evidence, working hypotheses, and value choices.
- [ ] I disclosed any interest that could affect this change, or none exists.
- [ ] I considered consent, accessibility, privacy, and who could be harmed.
- [ ] I included a reversible first step or explained why reversal is not possible.

## Proof

List the checks run and the visible result another person can verify.

## Follow-up

Name the owner, next review date, and any stop condition.
